build_video_processor_from_pretrained: build a video processor from a HuggingFace Hub model or local directory using from_pretrained
preprocess_videos_resize_normalize: preprocess a list of videos by resizing, center cropping, rescaling, and normalizing pixel values
sample_frames_uniformly_from_video: sample a fixed number of frames uniformly from a video given total duration and fps metadata
save_video_processor_to_disk: save a video processor configuration to a local directory as a JSON file
convert_video_tensor_to_rgb: convert a video tensor to RGB format handling grayscale and alpha channel blending
